summary: st-test takes a pool tree only when its build could get a heavy slot at once (more heavy slots free than heavy builds waiting, and build admission would admit it), bounded at 2700 s after which it takes the tree anyway; the pool counts its trees with the cargo shim's own heavy-slot formula (CARGO_HEAVY_SLOTS, then ~/.config/cargo-heavy-slots), and each run records and prints how long it waited for its tree, held it, and was blocked in it

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. The st-test runs file gains six fields (tree_wait_s, tree_slot_wait_s, tree_held_s, tree_blocked_s, tree_pre_start_s, tree_slot_blocked_s) on runs that take a pool tree; readers ignore fields they do not know.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required. What a run signs is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Runs re-execute main's st-test, so this applies to every run once it is on main. A host without the cargo shim's slot directory, or whose admission gate cannot be read, takes trees as before.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; the shim's queue is only read.
